name: Authorized admin inspects the search link and cancels without writing
covers: no external search of production names
description: Checks an authorized admin can inspect the customer search link and cancel the editor without changing fields or navigating to Google.
steps: Sign in with the authorized Google account
Wait until Google Sheets data is loaded
Open the edit form for a visible customer record without changing any field
Confirm the record identifier is read only
Inspect the company-name link without following it: verify the Google search URL matches the trimmed displayed name, target is _blank and rel contains noopener noreferrer
expected: The customer editor shows a read-only identifier and a correctly encoded, safe search link; cancel closes it without a Google search or any change to sheet data.

name: Google Sheets access failure shows the failing stage
description: Checks a failed source connection identifies whether authentication, API access, or schema validation failed without exposing secrets.
steps: Sign in while Google Sheets access is unavailable
Wait for the data request and connection status to settle
expected: The app distinguishes a connection or credential failure from a header mismatch and does not show Sandbox records.

name: Spreadsheet headers and tabs remain compatible
covers: customer, case, contact, task, document navigation
description: Checks the expected Google Sheet tabs and their schema are recognized by the application.
steps: Sign in with the authorized Google account
Open each of the five data tabs
Confirm each tab loads its matching table or displays a clear source error
expected: Each tab uses its Google Sheets data and no tab is silently populated from another source.

name: Customer name opens a read-only company profile
description: Verifies an authorized user can open the full registry details from a company name without changing the source.
steps: Sign in with the authorized Google account
Wait until Google Sheets data is loaded
Open the customer register and click a visible company name
Confirm the profile shows the customer ID and every registry field
expected: A read-only popup shows every customer field for the selected company, including empty fields as dashes, then closes without writing to Google Sheets.
